name: HR can create and deactivate a leave type, hiding it from new requests

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'hr@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Open the 'Leave Types' page via the sidebar link (URL /hr/leave-types).
Click the 'Add leave type' button. In the dialog, fill Name with 'E2E Personal Leave', set Attachment to 'Not required', set Default annual quota to 5, and click 'Save leave type'.
The leave types table now contains a row 'E2E Personal Leave' with 'Not required', '5 day(s)' and status 'Active'.
In that row, click the toggle button labelled 'Active' to deactivate it ('Deactivate this leave type').
The 'E2E Personal Leave' row now shows the status 'Inactive'.
Click the 'Log out' icon button, then log in with email 'flow.submit@leave-portal.test' and password 'password'.
The 'Leave type' dropdown does NOT contain the option 'E2E Personal Leave' (it was removed from the new request form because it is inactive).
